sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.1 - ai.meta.com
sources.snippet: Today, we're excited to introduce Muse Spark 1.1, the latest model from Meta Superintelligence Labs and a significant upgrade from Muse Spark. Muse Spark 1.1 is a multimodal reasoning model built for agentic tasks, with major gains in tool and computer use, coding, and multimodal understanding.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 — AI Model | MindStudio
sources.snippet: Muse Spark 1.1 is a text generation model published by Meta, classified as a chat-style large language model. It supports multimodal inputs including images, and offers a context window of 1,048,576 tokens alongside a maximum response size of 128,000 tokens.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 — Meta's Agentic Reasoning Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Muse Spark 1.1 is Meta Superintelligence Labs' upgrade to Muse Spark: a 1M-token multimodal reasoning model for agentic tasks, priced at $1.25/$4.25 per 1M tokens.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 API - Meta | AI Model APIs | AI Model APIs
sources.snippet: Build advanced reasoning agents with Muse Spark 1.1, a specialized AI model optimized for complex logic and chain-of-thought tasks. This model delivers cost-effective pricing at $1.25/1M input and $4.25/1M output tokens, native tool calling support. Access Muse Spark 1.1 via the Meta API with up to 32K output tokens.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 - ai.meta.com
sources.snippet: Muse Spark 1.1 Evaluation Report Muse Spark 1.1 is the latest release in the Muse Spark family of models developed by Meta. It builds upon Muse Spark 1.0, updating the model that powers Meta AI. Its availability is also extended to external developers through an application programming interface (API) with agentic affordances including tool and function calling.
